note: LaGrange County (IN) zoning districts are published only through the county's Beacon (Schneider Corp) web viewer, which is not a public ArcGIS REST service and returned a Cloudflare 403 to automated access. The county zoning ordinance and draft UDO are PDF text, not polygon data. No ArcGIS Hub/Online zoning layer for LaGrange County or its towns (LaGrange, Shipshewana, Topeka, Wolcottville) was found; the county's ArcGIS-hosted services directory was not reachable.
